acceptanceCriteria: A lane can finish its Tasks closeout before merge and the ticket completes when the merge lands without another gate run, or the refusal names the single post-merge command
body: Observed 2026-10-18 V1-1879 (attempt 211f3bd7, generation 735): submit and gate run focused-docs pass on the seal-commit tree; complete --commit <seal> refuses COMMIT_NOT_INTEGRATED and STALE_TREE because the commit is not on origin/main yet. With a merge queue (merge commit, new tree) the lane must wait for the merge, resubmit the merge tree, rerun the gate and complete; the lease must be kept alive for the CI duration (about 80 min measured on PR runs). Expected: a way to record a pending completion bound to the PR head that the store finalizes once the merge commit containing that tree diff lands, or complete accepting a merge commit whose first-parent diff equals the submitted change without a gate rerun.

holds.reason: Owner decision: binding completion to a merge-queue merge needs a design decision.

title: Tasks complete refuses COMMIT_NOT_INTEGRATED and STALE_TREE for a lane whose PR is armed for the merge queue, forcing a post-merge resubmit and gate rerun
